name: quoted-device-redirect-string-is-data-not-a-device-write
note: GUARD: `echo "> /dev/sda"` is a quoted string, not a redirect. The quote-aware redirect scanner must NOT surface disk.device:write, so deny-raw-device-write does NOT fire. With no rule allowing a bare echo, it fails closed to gommage. If the quote guard regressed and disk.device:write were emitted, the matched rule would change to the device deny — same decision kind, but the wrong reason. This fixture pins the decision to a non-hard-stop gommage; it is the determinism+mapper unit tests that pin which rule fires.
